name: Don't Fall Off Pikes Peak 2023

venue.name: Discovery Canyon Campus
venue.address: 1810 North Gate Blvd, Colorado Springs, CO, 80921
venue.details: Cafeteria - park in back bus/staff lots behind the school, enter through glass doors. See Travel tab for more info.

information:
We're excited to welcome competitors back to northern Colorado Springs for another fun day of speedcubing!

Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important!

* **Please read the travel tab before registering. Parking instructions are different than previous competitions at this venue!**
* **This competition has a 105 competitor limit.** Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition!
* Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition,[ this video ](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww)will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
* **If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team**, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 75 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of Friday, July 7, 6:00 PM MDT. 

This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!
